templates.purposeWebVerificationWhen: Sent the moment a visitor on this Station’s own website types their telephone number into the widget and asks to be identified. It has to be an approved template of Meta’s AUTHENTICATION category: the visitor has never messaged this Station, so there is no 24-hour window to send inside. Until it is registered here the widget accepts a number and then sends nothing at all.
templates.purposeWebVerificationSendsCode: The six-digit code, and nothing else — it expires in ten minutes and is burned after five wrong attempts
templates.purposeParticipationConfirmedWhen: Sent on the WhatsApp fast path the moment a listener's own hashtag enters them in a promotion outright, with nothing left for the bot to ask.
templates.purposeParticipationDuplicateWhen: Sent when a listener's hashtag names a promotion they have already entered, whatever else that promotion asks for. It usually comes from the check that runs ahead of the fast path, and from the fast path itself when two messages race and the second one loses.
templates.purposeParticipationTooSoonWhen: Sent when the promotion enforces a minimum wait between entries and this listener's last one has not cleared it yet.

connectWhatsApp.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
connectWhatsApp.description: Pairs this Station's own WhatsApp Business account with PulchatX so that both share one telephone number: the Station keeps answering from the WhatsApp Business app while this system sends and receives on the same number. Meta runs the pairing itself, in a separate window, and asks for a confirmation code delivered to the telephone — have the handset with you before you start.
connectWhatsApp.notConfigured: Meta's pairing address has not been configured on this installation, so the pairing cannot be started from here. It is a setting on the server rather than something this screen can fix — ask support.
